name: ExaBGP
description: BGP Swiss Army Knife of networking. BGP implementation enabling interaction with BGP networks using Python scripts or external programs via a simple JSON API.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Images published on GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io/exa-networks/exabgp:latest). Dockerfile present in repo.

eval_notes: Powerful BGP traffic generator and route injector. Does NOT manipulate the FIB. Ideal for testing BGP policies, DDoS mitigation via FlowSpec, and traffic engineering in agentic evaluations.
